fact: On 13 May 2026 (5 Ginbot 2018 EC) the ECA Director General said the Authority is carrying out personal data protection under Proclamation 1321/2016 EC, that institutions misusing data are liable, and that a portal for reporting data breaches to the regulator has been prepared.
title: የግለሰቦችን የግል መረጃ ለታለመለት ዓላማ ብቻ ማዋል የሚያስችል የተጠናከረ የግል ዳታ ጥበቃ እየተከናወነ ነው
